items.t: AST SpaceMobile Sinks 6%, Rocket Lab Down 5% as Space Stocks Give Back a Stellar Week
items.sum: Key TakeawaysAST SpaceMobile fell 6% today with no company news, as Rocket Lab, Intuitive Machines and Firefly Aerospace slid on hot inflation data. Intuitive Machines fell almost as hard a day after a record quarter, so this looks like a sector pullback more than a verdict on AST.

items.t: Intuitive Machines Falls 7% Despite Record Quarter as Space Stocks Slide; AST SpaceMobile Sinks 9%, Rocket Lab Drops 5%
items.sum: Intuitive Machines just posted a record backlog and soaring revenue, yet its shares are sliding with the rest of the space sector. Behind the headline numbers sit one-time gains, a shrinking cash pile, and a lunar mission clock that investors are watching closely.

items.t: SpaceX's Starship Flight 15, Rocket Lab's Electron Ready For Milestone Missions
items.sum: SpaceX is hours away from its Starship Flight 15 launch, planning a double-catch for the Starship and booster. Rocket Lab preps for 100th Electron mission.

items.t: Rocket Lab Is Up 28% in a Year, Down 57% From May’s High: Take Profits, or Load Up?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysRocket Lab stock is up 28% in a year but sits 57% below its May high. The business kept growing: third-quarter revenue hit a record $268 million, up 73%, and backlog reached a record $3.
